name: McGill Hall
provenance: UC San Diego Facilities floor plans, converted for the classroom explorer. Rooms are scaled from their official areas and fitted to the campus-map footprint. Added 2342, 2334, 2330, 2322, 2315 from the retained public FIS raster. New geometry is manually traced and approximately registered; existing rooms and levels are retained. The inherited local frame is reflected relative to the north-up 2022 L2 plan. Existing floor geometry is retained and the new rooms are registered to that same frame, but campus placement and a reliable north angle are withheld until the original lower-floor orientation can be independently checked.

sources.publisher: UC San Diego Facilities Information System
notes: Native stitched raster; manually reviewed room labels and boundaries.
Five L2 rooms are traced from directly readable labels and walls in the 2022 public FIS drawing; 2331 remains unplaced because its number is not shown.
Small column and doorway details are simplified. Printed areas are an independent consistency check; geometry and placement remain approximate.

The inherited local frame is reflected relative to the north-up 2022 L2 plan. Existing floor geometry is retained and the new rooms are registered to that same frame, but campus placement and a reliable north angle are withheld until the original lower-floor orientation can be independently checked.
All existing rooms, floor outlines and levels are retained. The original L1-derived slab includes an inherited hole that is not verified for L2; the new rooms do not rely on that hole.
The displayed FIS source warns it may be out of date. A public L1 request returned a login response, so no unsupported whole-building correction was made.
